title: Generalized Hyperrectangular Prediction Sets in Multivariate Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.05543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multivariate conformal prediction, many nonconformity scores yield prediction sets with complex geometry (e.g., ellipsoids or density level sets) that are difficult to interpret and visualize. Hyperrectangles offer a practical alternative by providing one interval per output. We extend this notion to Cartesian products of arbitrary one-dimensional sets, which we call generalized hyperrectangles. We introduce a rectangularization framework that turns any continuous multivariate nonconformity score, or conditional density, into one yielding generalized hyperrectangular prediction sets with finite-sample coverage. We establish key geometric properties of our rectangularization framework and provide useful intuitions on generalized hyperrectangles. We further establish a representation theorem showing that a broad class of hyperrectangular conformal methods based on max-aggregated coordinate-wise scores can be interpreted as rectangular

translated_title: 多变量保形预测中的广义超矩形预测集
translated_abstract: 在多变量保形预测中，许多非一致性分数所产生的预测集具有复杂的几何形状（例如椭球或密度水平集），难以解释和可视化。超矩形通过为每个输出提供一个区间，提供了一种实用的替代方案。我们将这一概念扩展到任意一维集合的笛卡尔积，并称之为广义超矩形。我们引入了一个矩形化框架，能够将任何连续的多变量非一致性分数或条件密度转换为可产生具有有限样本覆盖保证的广义超矩形预测集的分数。我们建立了该矩形化框架的关键几何性质，并就广义超矩形提供了有益的直观理解。我们进一步建立了一个表示定理，表明基于坐标分数最大聚合的一大类超矩形保形方法可以被解释为矩形化（框架的特例）。
tldr: 该论文提出广义超矩形预测集及一个矩形化框架，能将任意连续的多变量非一致性分数或条件密度转化为具有有限样本覆盖保证、且易于解释和可视化的超矩形预测集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes generalized hyperrectangular prediction sets and a rectangularization framework that transforms any continuous multivariate nonconformity score or conditional density into one yielding interpretable hyperrectangular prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
